item.title: Kokoro Hokenshitsu ~Kimi to Naisho no Counseling~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Custard
  • 発売日: 2009-01-23
  • スコア: 6.659999999999999/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ココロ保健室～キミとナイショのカウンセリング～
  • 英語名: Kokoro Hokenshitsu Kimi to Naisho no Counseling

あらすじ

There is a boarding school in the town. It is well-known as a prestige school, but most of the students have complicating family problems. Yes, the school was actually founded by the government for those students. One day, a transfer student comes to the school. He is quiet and polite, so he soon becomes friends with other classmates. As a matter of fact, he is an efficient counselor sent by the board of education. He acts as a student outwardly, but he secretly starts counseling to the girls in trouble….
